neighbours.label: the words ' quick' and ' brief' (adjectives of brevity)
fire: Can we have a quick chat after lunch?
The manager gave a brief speech at the party.
I sent him a quick reply from the train.
After a brief pause, the singer continued.
She took a quick shower before dinner.
There was a brief power cut last night.
He made a quick sketch of the bridge.
The doctor gave us a brief explanation.
quiet: Can we have a long chat after lunch?
The manager gave a short speech at the party.
I sent him a rapid reply from the train.
After a long pause, the singer continued.
She took a hot shower before dinner.
There was a short power cut last night.
He made a rough sketch of the bridge.
The doctor gave us a clear explanation.
